newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares up at noon on support buying.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares up at noon on support buying.

text.p: Shanghai B shares were up at midday on Monday on institutional support buying in shares with a heavy index weighting including Pudong real estate shares, brokers said.
But trading volume was thin with most investors sidelined waiting for the listing of Jinan Qingqi Motorcycle Co's 230 million B shares on Tuesday, they said.
The B index rose 1.243 points or 1.48 percent to 85.174 points on volume of 6.005 million shares worth $3.717 million.
"The A share rebound sparked domestic buying mainly in Pudong shares, but follow-up buying was limited with most investors still cautious due to a lack positive market factors," one broker said.
"The performance of Jinan Jingqi will have a great impact on the B share market with its huge capitalization," another broker said.
Brokers said technical charts showed the upward potential of the rebound was limited with no solid positive news expected in the short term.
Of 43 B shares, 32 traded, with 27 up, three flat and two down.
Shanghai Waigaoqiao Free Trade Zone Development was the star, rising $0.028 or 5.09 percent to $0.578 on volume of 455,800 shares.
Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development was the most actively traded on institutional support, gaining $0.004 or 0.46 percent to $0.862 on volume of 957,000 shares.
Shanghai's A share index extended its Friday's rebound on bargain-hunting, but its upward potential is limited due to a lack of fresh capital, brokers said.

The index moved up 21.267 points or 1.64 percent to 1,320.189 points on volume of 246.2 million shares worth 3.4 billion yuan. The SSE30 blue chip index rose 75.514 points or 1.97 percent to 3,900.901 points.

Shanghai Jiabao Industry and Commerce was the best performer on institutional speculative buying, surging 1.13 yuan or 10.01 percent to 12.41 yuan on volume of 1.9 million shares. --Shanghai newsroom (86-21) 6279-7004
